name: Brayden Zink
headline: Construction Project Management
valueProposition: I translate financial, operational and field data into actionable insights for construction project teams.
intro: I'm a Master of Business and Technology student at Purdue University's Daniels School of Business, with an interdisciplinary background in business and engineering. As a project management intern at E&B Paving, I analyzed job costs, built forecasts and worked with both field crews and leadership.

education.school: Purdue University, Daniels School of Business

education.degree: Bachelor of Science, Integrated Business and Engineering

pillars.title: Cost and forecasting
pillars.description: At E&B Paving, I analyzed job cost reports and built forecasts across four projects, and I helped reallocate surplus materials for over $160,000 in company savings.

pillars.title: Field experience
pillars.description: I worked alongside asphalt and concrete crews on seven projects and partnered with a survey engineer to check grade and elevation on four.

pillars.title: Leadership
pillars.description: At Purdue, I led an EPICS project team, engaged prospective students as a Business Ambassador and co-lead a Christian community through Salt Company.

leadership.title: EPICS team leader
leadership.description: Led a multidisciplinary Purdue EPICS team in completing the design and development of a wheelchair training platform within one semester, after taking over the project midway.

leadership.title: Business Ambassadors
leadership.description: Engaged prospective students through Business Ambassadors, helping increase overall yield at the Daniels School of Business from 20.8% to 27.4% in 2024.

leadership.title: Salt Company co-leader
leadership.description: Co-lead a Christian-based community focused on worship, fellowship and Gospel study.

leadership.title: Community food drive
leadership.description: Collected more than 1,400 pounds of food for families in the greater Lafayette area for three consecutive years.
